reserveReview.rationale: Issuer terms, whitepaper and reserve FAQ were reopened on 2026-10-15. They describe same-currency cash and high-quality liquid financial assets in segregated accounts, without a dated itemized portfolio, named current banks or signed reserve-to-liability reconciliation. The FAQ's 30% minimum deposit requirement is a legal floor, not measured allocation. The 100% slice denotes the entire unclassified book, not a backing ratio; advertised 102% remains an issuer assertion without measured collateralization credit. The signed supply feed reports liabilities and the reports API provides customer statements, neither reserve composition nor financial assurance. Medium legacy risk retains unsplit-basket uncertainty rather than assuming Treasury-only backing.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Issuer-disclosed asset-class mandate; no measured current weights
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The whole reserve book lacks itemized assets, counterparty weights and an independently reconciled liability denominator.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Whitepaper D.3 describes a distinct patrimony and the issuer says reserves are separate, not lent or commingled. Actual banks, account agreements, allocation, replacement mechanics and practical insolvency enforceability are not public in the retrieved material. The whole-book custody summary therefore remains unknown.
